stations.title: Bridie
stations.say: The child fare is in three places.
stations.note: One rule, written out each time.

stations.title: Ossian's count
stations.text: Takes people off, but the seats never drop

stations.title: Ticket hut
stations.text: Each rule written once, used everywhere.

captions: The ticket hut. Bridie wants each fare rule in one place, not in every program.
Today the rules are copied by hand, and Ossian's seat count never goes down.
You write methods that take values and give one back, and fix Ossian's.
Now a family's fare comes from one rule, and the seat count follows each boarding.
Methods, return and void. Next, a whole day of counts kept in one place.
